# appsignal_organization (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up the organization configured on the provider.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Get the organization configured on the provider
data "appsignal_organization" "org" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The organization id.
- `name` (String) The name of the organization.
- `slug` (String) The slug of the organization, as configured on the provider.
